Partager en deux.

examples.text: Sie können gern das ganze Brot kaufen, ich kann es jedoch gern halbieren.
examples.translation: Vous pouvez acheter le pain entier, mais je peux volotiers le couper en deux.

examples.text: einen Apfel halbieren.
Nun halbieren Sie die Zwetschgen, entfernen die Kerne und schneiden die Zwetschgen noch etwas ein. Große Zwetschgen können sie auch vierteln.
examples.translation: Coupez maintenant les quetsches en deux, retirez les noyaux et incisez encore un peu les quetsches. Vous pouvez également couper les grosses quetsches en quatre.

glosses: transitif Réduire de moitié.

examples.text: Der Kanzlerkandidat versprach, die Arbeitslosigkeit innerhalb von zwei Jahren zu halbieren.
examples.translation: Le candidat à la chancellerie a promis de réduire le chômage de moitié en deux ans.

glosses: Se réduire de moitié.

examples.text: Durch Kompression des Datenstromes halbieren sich die Anforderungen an die Bandbreite für die Übertragung.
examples.translation: Grâce à la compression du flux de données, les exigences en matière de bande passante pour la transmission se réduisent de moitié.

glosses: To reduce to half the original amount.

examples.text: These show that since 1946 the fatality rate in train and movement accidents combined has been halved, [...].

The difficulty of each puzzle would increase as the number of miners increased, which would keep production to one block of transactions roughly every 10 minutes. In addition, the size of each block bounty would halve every 210,000 blocks—first from 50 bitcoins to 25, then from 25 to 12.5, and so on. Around the year 2140, the currency would reach its preordained limit of 21 million bitcoins.

glosses: To divide into two halves.
To make up half of.

examples.text: So far apart their lives are thrown / From the twin soul that halves their own.

glosses: To join two pieces of timber etc. by cutting away each for half its thickness at the joining place, and fitting together.
In match play, to achieve a tie or draw on.

examples.text: I, of course, had no difficulty in doing likewise, and we halved the hole; but the awkward fact remained that I must now gain every hole to win the match, for my opponent's score was "nine up," and there only remained ten holes to play.
All that counts is whether you won, lost, or halved the match.
